solutions.latex:
After 5 quizzes, Stan's total $=50$ and Ollie's total $=70$.

Stan's required total $=84$

$\therefore$ he needs 34 more marks, so an average of 17 per quiz.

Combined total $=16\times14=224$

This leaves Ollie to score $224-(84+70)=70$ marks.

As each quiz is worth 20 marks his task is impossible.
